executiveSummary: Pending PVCs are the most immediate reliability risk in this snapshot because they can block stateful workload recovery and rollout convergence.

confidenceLimiters: Storage root cause still needs class-level and event-level verification.
Stateful remediation has elevated blast radius and should stay manual-first.

keyFindings.title: 2 persistent volume claim(s) are Pending
keyFindings.whyItMatters: Pending claims can block stateful workload scheduling, prolong incidents, and turn restarts into outages.

immediate.title: Inspect PVC events, StorageClass binding mode, and matching PV capacity before any workload restart
immediate.expectedBenefit: Avoids turning a storage provisioning issue into a broader incident.
immediate.riskTradeoff: Takes more operator time before mitigation, but reduces stateful blast radius.

proposedOperatorMessage: Kube Ops Copilot: pending PVCs are the most urgent reliability issue here. Verify storage binding/provisioning before restarting any stateful workload.
hiddenRisks: A stateful rollout can look like an application incident when the real blocker is storage binding.
unknowns: Need PVC events and CSI provisioner logs to confirm whether the issue is capacity, topology, or class misconfiguration.
finalOperatorVerdict: Keep remediation manual-first until storage root cause is confirmed.
